name: code-simplifier
description: Review and simplify implementation code for readability without changing behavior or taking over the project's workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Spot avoidable complexity while preserving behavior
interface.longDescription: Review implementation code for speculative branches, redundant abstractions, and hard-to-follow business flow. During authorized edits, simplify only the task's scope while keeping contracts, permissions, transactions, and side effects intact.
defaultPrompt: Review this code for avoidable complexity and behavior risks.
Simplify the authorized changes while preserving behavior.
